name: LDPE Film Pouch
typical_use_case: Bulk grain, legumes, low-barrier applications
description: Low-Density Polyethylene flexible film. Good moisture barrier but very poor oxygen barrier. Inexpensive and widely available. Not suitable for fat-rich or oxygen-sensitive products.

name: BOPP Film Pouch
typical_use_case: Snacks, dry spices, biscuits
description: Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene. Better clarity and stiffness than LDPE. Good moisture barrier, moderate oxygen barrier. Used extensively for dry snack packaging.

name: Metallised BOPP Pouch
typical_use_case: Chips, fried snacks, light-sensitive dry products
description: Aluminium-metallised BOPP. Excellent moisture and oxygen barrier. Blocks light. Very common for Indian snack packaging (Kurkure, chips). Not transparent.

name: Aluminium Foil Laminate (Al-Foil / PET-Al-PE)
typical_use_case: Ghee, butter, dairy fat products, pharmaceutical packaging
description: Multi-layer laminate with aluminium foil core. Near-zero WVTR and OTR. Perfect barrier for highly perishable, fat-rich, or light-sensitive products. Higher cost.

name: PET / Al / PE Retort Pouch
typical_use_case: Ready-to-eat curries, mango pulp, high-moisture processed foods
description: Retort-grade multilayer pouch suitable for high-temperature sterilisation. Withstands 121°C retort process. Used for shelf-stable wet food products.

name: HDPE Rigid Container
typical_use_case: Ghee tins (alternative), jaggery blocks, coarse powders
description: High-Density Polyethylene rigid container. Excellent crush resistance. Good moisture barrier. Moderate oxygen barrier. Translucent to opaque.

name: Glass Jar with Metal Lid
typical_use_case: Honey, pickles, jams, artisan products, premium retail
description: Soda-lime glass with tin lid. Perfect barrier when sealed. Heavy, fragile under impact but high crush resistance on flat surfaces. Does NOT block light unless dark glass is used. Premium feel.

name: Amber / Dark Glass Jar
typical_use_case: Essential oils, light-sensitive honey, saffron, ayurvedic products
description: Amber-coloured glass with lid. Blocks UV and visible light. Excellent all-around barrier. Heavy and breakable but premium shelf appeal for small-batch artisan products.

name: Kraft Paper Bag (Plain)
typical_use_case: Dry grains, flour (short shelf life), non-food applications
description: Plain uncoated kraft paper bag. Very high WVTR and OTR — almost no barrier. Fully biodegradable. Only suitable for short shelf life dry products stored in low-humidity environments.

name: PE-Coated Kraft Paper Bag
typical_use_case: Flour, atta, sugar, moderate shelf-life dry goods
description: Kraft paper with thin PE coating on the inside. Substantially improved moisture barrier over plain kraft. Partially biodegradable (paper component). Moderate oxygen barrier.

name: Vacuum Skin Pack (VSP) Film
typical_use_case: Fresh paneer, cheese, processed meats, fresh fish
description: High-barrier film for vacuum skin packaging. Film conforms tightly to the product surface, creating near-vacuum conditions. Very effective for fresh dairy and perishable proteins.

name: MAP Film (Modified Atmosphere)
typical_use_case: Fresh leafy vegetables, fresh-cut fruits, high-respiration produce
description: Perforated or microperforated film designed to balance O₂/CO₂ transmission for fresh produce. High OTR allows respiration gases to exchange. Specifically designed for MAP applications.

name: Tin Can (Steel, 3-piece)
typical_use_case: Ghee (1L/5L), cooking oil, processed fruit pulp, tomato paste
description: Electroplated tin-coated steel can. Completely impermeable barrier. Excellent crush resistance. Light-blocking. Recyclable metal. Higher cost and weight than plastic alternatives.

name: PLA Bioplastic Pouch
typical_use_case: Dry organic products, short shelf life eco-branded goods
description: Polylactic acid compostable film. Fully biodegradable in industrial composting conditions. Moderate barrier properties. More expensive than conventional plastics. Not suitable for high-moisture or long shelf-life products.

name: Wax-Coated Paper Wrap
typical_use_case: Jaggery wrapping, artisan dairy, short shelf life bakery
description: Food-grade wax-impregnated kraft paper. Improved moisture resistance over plain paper. Sustainable choice for short-shelf-life products. Poor oxygen barrier.

name: EVOH Multilayer Barrier Film
typical_use_case: High-fat products (nuts, cooking oils, fat spreads) requiring extreme O₂ barrier without aluminium foil
description: Ethylene Vinyl Alcohol multilayer film. Extraordinary oxygen barrier (OTR near 1 cc/m²/day) without metal content. Transparent. Used where foil is undesirable (microwave) but excellent O₂ barrier is required.

name: PP Rigid Tray with Lidding Film
typical_use_case: Fresh paneer retail packs, dairy desserts, cut vegetables
description: Polypropylene thermoformed tray heat-sealed with barrier lidding film. Good crush resistance and presentation. Moderate barrier properties; often nitrogen-flushed for perishable dairy.

name: Jute / Hessian Bag
typical_use_case: Bulk grains, potatoes, onions (short-term transport), agri commodities
description: Natural woven jute sacking. Virtually no moisture or gas barrier. Allows airflow — suitable for produce requiring ventilation. Fully biodegradable and recyclable. Not suitable for packaged retail.

name: Aseptic Carton (Tetra Pak style)
typical_use_case: UHT milk, fruit juices, mango pulp B2C, flavoured beverages
description: Multi-layer paperboard / PE / Al / PE carton. Excellent barrier. Light-blocking. Shelf-stable for 6–12 months at ambient temperature. Widely used in Indian dairy and beverage sector.

name: HDPE Woven PP Sack
typical_use_case: Rice (25/50 kg), flour, sugar, bulk pulses
description: Woven polypropylene sack with or without LDPE liner. Standard Indian commodity packaging for staple grains. Adequate moisture barrier when lined. Very low oxygen barrier.
